checks.evidence: The public product is organized as small simulated views instead of a single dense page.
checks.recommendation: Keep the navigation split into home, results, laws in treatment, topics, detail, how-to-read and sources.

checks.evidence: Search is a first-class flow and relies on backend result classification.
checks.recommendation: Keep search centered on plain-language queries and avoid frontend-only semantic guessing.

checks.evidence: User-provided view, tab, id and query values are whitelisted, bounded or escaped before rendering or API calls.
checks.recommendation: Keep route and query validation explicit as new views are added.

checks.evidence: Home does not render shortcut chips below the search box.
checks.recommendation: Organize discovery through views and sections, not highlighted shortcuts.

checks.evidence: The UI uses neutral terms and removes the arbitrary important-norms section.
checks.recommendation: Avoid ranking legal materials as important unless a governed criterion is approved.

checks.evidence: The home introduces the product and sends users to separate views for deeper reading.
checks.recommendation: Do not move dense legal comparisons back onto the home page.

checks.evidence: Proposal detail is split into summary, comparison, sources and data status tabs.
checks.recommendation: Use tabs for peer-level detail sections so the user chooses depth intentionally.

checks.evidence: Individual article-level diffs are collapsed into accordions.
checks.recommendation: Keep individual diff units expandable so long legal text does not dominate the page.

checks.evidence: Long current/proposed legal texts are constrained inside internal scroll panels.
checks.recommendation: Keep original legal text available without turning detail pages into endless scrolling.

checks.evidence: The default detail tab gives a plain-language summary before comparison.
checks.recommendation: Do not lead non-legal users directly into dense legal text.

checks.evidence: Every loaded diff keeps what-changes and what-it-means explanations visible.
checks.recommendation: Keep simple explanation separate from original text and source blocks.

checks.evidence: Proposal and diff views expose agenda, current text and proposed text source states.
checks.recommendation: Never hide source state behind interpretation.

checks.evidence: Missing original links are explicit and visible.
checks.recommendation: Keep pending source states visible instead of inventing links.

checks.evidence: The UI has an explicit empty state for proposals without loaded legal texts.
checks.recommendation: Show pending comparison states transparently and keep source blocks accessible.

checks.evidence: Public proposal cards and diff cards expose validated, partial, assisted and unresolved states.
checks.recommendation: Never show an assisted or partial diff as if it were fully validated.

checks.evidence: The productive public seed uses official Senate agenda items and no fictional or Diputados data in this vertical slice.
checks.recommendation: Keep demo/test data out of the public product.

checks.evidence: Already-treated laws have an honest empty state instead of invented data.
checks.recommendation: Keep empty states explicit while datasets are incomplete.

checks.evidence: The interface warns that it is not personalized legal advice.
checks.recommendation: Avoid imperative advice for individual legal situations.

checks.evidence: The shell has language, landmarks, hidden labels, focus target and tab states.
checks.recommendation: Keep accessible labels and focus management explicit as views grow.

checks.evidence: How-to-read is a brief visual guide rather than a dense explanation.
checks.recommendation: Keep the guide short and focused on reading the interface.

checks.evidence: CSS defines responsive breakpoints, collapses dense grids and accounts for the global search.
checks.recommendation: Verify real mobile screenshots before production announcements.

checks.evidence: Typography avoids negative letter spacing and viewport-scaled font sizes.
checks.recommendation: Use fixed/rem sizes and responsive containers instead of viewport font scaling.

checks.evidence: The static shell does not depend on third-party runtime assets.
checks.recommendation: Keep the MVP shell self-contained for Cloudflare Pages.

checks.evidence: The operational page remains separate from the public legal-diff UX.
checks.recommendation: Keep protected actions token-gated and outside the public reading flow.
